heroText: Control the intensity level and temperature for each environment or need.
featureTitle: Voice controlled and adjustable in intensity
featureText1: Smart lighting also controls the intensity of the light and offers a wide range of colors to create different scenarios in the same environment.
featureText2: This technology can save up to 90% on your electricity bill.
featureCard1Text1: Turn the lights you need on and off with the help of your favorite assistant or even Amazon Alexa.
featureCard1Text2: Did you forget to turn off the kitchen light and don't want to get up? Just ask your assistant.
featureCard2Text: Our bulbs are installed in a simple way without affecting the aesthetics of your spaces, they can be controlled from any mobile device.
featureCard3Text: Being smart lights, we can also regulate the intensity of the light or even schedule on and off times, all of which allows us to save money on the electricity bill.
